title: GamiBench: Evaluating Spatial Reasoning and 2D-to-3D Planning Capabilities of MLLMs with Origami Folding Tasks
reasoning: The paper focuses exclusively on benchmarking spatial reasoning and 2D-to-3D planning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) using origami-inspired tasks. It does not contain any evaluation or discussion related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
